aarti.tek: O mind, perform such an āratī of Rāma, hero of the Raghus, who takes away sorrow and the pairs of opposites, Govinda, dense with bliss.
aarti.pad1: Hari, in the forms of all that moves and does not move, pervades all and dwells everywhere always: offer this conviction as incense. Self-knowledge is the lamp, by which the darkness of anger, arrogance and delusion is gone, and deep-rooted pride and the turnings of the mind waste away. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Feeling, exceedingly pure and choice, is the auspicious food-offering that gives supreme contentment to the Lord of Śrī. Love is the betel, by which every pain and doubt is gone, and which takes away the many seeds of worldly desire. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Ten wicks steeped in the ghee of deeds bad and good, renunciation the fire and sattva the light: offer this row of lamps of devotion, dispassion and realised knowledge as āratī to the Lord in whom the world dwells. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: In the spotless house of the heart a fair couch of peace is made, where King Śrī Rāma lies down to rest. Forgiveness, compassion and the like are the handmaids there; where Hari is, there is no māyā of difference. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Sanaka and his brothers, the Vedas, Śeṣa, Śiva, the divine sage Nārada and all the sages who see the truth are devoted to this āratī. Whoever performs it crosses the ocean of worldly existence and casts off the filth of desire and the rest: so says the servant Tulasīdāsa, pure of mind. ॥5॥
